sentence.protectedClass: consumers who opt out of the sale of their personal information
sentence.preventOutcome: their personal information still reaching a third party for cross-context behavioral advertising

legitimateUses.scenario: An opted-out consumer's data goes to a service provider under a written contract, only to process the business's payments, and the business pays the provider for that service.
The consumer asks the business to send her data to a specific company she chose, and the business does so.
Before the consumer opts out, the business sells her data to a third party for money and shows a 'Do Not Sell My Personal Information' link on its homepage.
